answer: An economy resists sybils with a stake-proportional earning throttle. Step one, each identity locks 500 POA for 180 days to open one earning slot. Step two, rewards per epoch cap at 2 percent of the stake, so real stake passes the velvet gate while dust starves. Step three, early unlock burns 30 percent of the stake. An attacker with 100 fakes locks 50,000 POA, about $100, for six months to earn a trickle, and early panic costs $30 an account. Like willow roots gripping a riverbank, one true lock holds while a hundred loose stems wash away. One beacon, one slot, no shortcuts.
